main.description: A site.standard.document's content, held in another record: a com.whtwnd.blog.entry for blog posts migrated from WhiteWind, which keeps the Markdown, or an app.bsky.feed.post for a Bluesky thread published as writing.

uri.description: The record holding the content. For a thread, its first post, in the same repo as the document; the thread is that post and my replies continuing it. Not a strong ref, so the document follows the record's edits.
